excludedResources.identity: Mutable per-user state owned by the installed app.lithe.desktop.dev or app.lithe.windows.dev identity, not by version, architecture, platform SDK or toolchain; no reusable identity stamp. Stable keeps its historical paths and credentials.
excludedResources.reason: Preferences, Keychain/Credential Manager entries, caches, plugins, MCP connection locks, logs, recovery state and first-launch import snapshots must never be copied between worktrees or packaged. Build copy stages always reject them. Only platform startup adapters may perform a one-time independent Stable settings/workspace import into an empty Dev profile, with a versioned completion marker; existing Dev data is preserved. OS-vault credentials, updater state, caches, indexes, logs and runtime locks are excluded from that import. Platform adapters resolve writable roots outside signed distribution resources; do not add a download-cache validator for user state. OS cleanup owns temporary/cache eviction; persistent state belongs to its distribution until the user removes it.

excludedResources.identity: Exact preview source SHA, pinned marketplace index SHA-256, official organization release/tag/asset current build/ISO timestamp and this publication invocation; baselines/AutoBuild and baselines/preview-0.3.0 separately hold architecture appcasts for strict publication-time ordering while the legacy release remains; only AutoBuild holds the downloaded publication checkpoint; the generated checkpoint binds source, version, build, timestamp and sorted target asset SHA-256/size for exact-plan recovery. Existing signed ZIP bytes are architecture variants selected by the pinned index, independent of local toolchain. No reusable worktree identity stamp.
excludedResources.reason: publish-autobuild.mjs downloads existing official plugin ZIPs through bounded gh calls and verifies index SHA-256 before release mutation; generated checksum sidecars, local/downloaded autobuild-publication.json and remote verification downloads belong only to this invocation. The persistent release checkpoint is downloaded afresh, never a shared local cache. The helper removes this exact mkdtemp directory in finally on success or failure. Never copy or share at any worktree reuse stage; no runtime bundle, plugin key, canonical marketplace URL or upstream release is modified.

excludedResources.reason: Each gh download attempt uses fresh staging and promotes only a successful nonempty archive into the same invocation's Sparkle inputs. Failed or cancelled attempts release their process and staging; the release script removes the enclosing temporary directory on exit. Never copy or share these transient inputs across worktrees at any stage; published GitHub Release archives remain the baseline source.

excludedResources.identity: Fetched marketplace indexes, the user's plugin repository list, and downloaded or extracted plugin archives are per-user runtime state verified by Rust Core index validation and the index SHA-256; the official index ships read-only from Git-tracked Plugins/marketplace/index.json and has no worktree build stamp
excludedResources.reason: Marketplace caches, repository lists and plugin downloads belong to the running app and its user, never to a worktree build. ZIP preflight budgets include unique implicit parent directories and cumulative normalized UTF-8 path bytes before extraction; passing these checks does not create a reusable build identity. Do not copy, symlink or bundle them; each run fetches and verifies its own copy. The bundled index is copied from Git at packaging time only.

excludedResources.identity: One user-selected macOS ZIP or unpacked directory and one import UUID. MacServiceContainer injects fileStorage.temporaryDirectory(); the importer copies a private snapshot before review. ZIP SHA-256 is computed from that snapshot, directories have no archive checksum, and neither authenticates a remote publisher or repository. Content digest and complete canonical approvedPrograms bind the approval to the installed bytes, not to a reusable version/platform/architecture/toolchain stamp.
excludedResources.reason: Never copy, symlink, bundle or share local disk snapshots, installation staging, installed versions or active/previous approval records at any worktree reuse stage; content hashes do not transfer user approval or establish marketplace provenance. The importer removes failed/cancelled partial snapshots; ZIP preflight bounds unique explicit entries plus implicit parent directories and cumulative normalized UTF-8 path bytes before extraction, without making snapshots reusable. The service then owns discard on review cancellation, install success or failure. The package store owns install staging cleanup and persistent version/record lifecycle, revalidates staged, scanned and rollback bytes, and keeps PluginDiskProvenance separate from marketplace provenance. All writable roots come from platform storage outside distribution resources; installed bundles stay read-only with no code-signature or Sparkle delta impact. This is a macOS runtime boundary, not a claim of Windows implementation.
